entities.summary: The Kharkiv State Academy of Design and Arts or KSADA (ХДАДМ) is a Kharkiv-based state institution of higher education in design, visual arts, and culture. Located in Kharkiv, the Academy is overseen by the Ministry of Culture of Ukraine, and currently hosts approximately 1,450 students, including international students.
